patterns: Post-Halloween lull: no watchlist post and no outsider in the last 24h crossed 5K (top outsider 1.6K, a Grok Imagine promo). Sunday 1 November is All Saints / All Souls weekend, so the spooky lane is still warm but nobody owns it today

Ask-Grok question hook keeps compounding: lexx_aura's 'Hey @grok, explain it simply, as if I were a 10-year-old child? Why can't build a bridge like this?' grew from 63.7K to 102K in a day (Fri 15:32). Impossible visual plus a naive question to @grok is the strongest repeatable hook on the watchlist this week

First-person one-take is new: zzhan8's 'First-person one-take x4 with Anubis after training' (Seedance 2.5) hit 97K in 47h. POV camera that never cuts, walking straight into a mythic creature, fits dark fantasy perfectly

The 'This AI video is absolutely masterpiece' + tool name formula still prints when the clip is strong: xIrissy 51K, kingofdairyque 'literally masterpiece, made with seedance 2.5' 8.5K (Sat 06:02), and ThatsEFM copied 'Malfoy is Hot Blooded' to 119K. Short caption, one hook line, tool name, video does the rest

Posting discipline: @phulskamp posted 3 originals in 42 minutes this Sunday morning (08:20-09:02, 5-17 views) and 6 in 48h, best 51 (Halloween Nightmare King, Fri 10:48). Titles still use em dashes. One post per slot, hook line before the title, and the watchlist hits land Fri/Sat 15:30-18:00 Amsterdam

drafts.title: 🐉 I WALKED INTO THE DRAGON'S CRYPT
drafts.text:
First-person, one take, no cuts. I walked into a dragon's crypt 🐉👇

🐉 I WALKED INTO THE DRAGON'S CRYPT 🐉

I pushed the iron door aside,
the torches bowed, the shadows sighed.
A golden eye began to burn,
and told me I would not return.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
The full prompt is in the comments 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10-12s, POV camera that never cuts. Second 0: your own gloved hands push open a huge iron door and torches flare along the walls. Keep walking forward down stone stairs over piles of gold and bones, then the floor moves: a giant golden eye opens right in front of the lens, smoke rolls out, end on the eye filling the frame.

drafts.title: 🌕 THE CITY CHAINED TO THE MOON

Hey @grok, explain it like I'm 10: how could a city hang from the moon like this? 🌕⛓️👇

🌕 THE CITY CHAINED TO THE MOON 🌕

They chained their towers to the moon,
and swore the world would follow soon.
But every night the chains grow thin,
and something old is climbing in.

Second 0: extreme close-up of a giant rusted chain creaking upward, then the camera tilts up and reveals a gothic city hanging upside down from a huge pale moon on hundreds of chains. Slow push in on lit windows, then one chain snaps with sparks and a dark winged shape crawls over the rooftops toward the camera.
